issue.body:
### Current retest status — 14 October 2026 (JST)

**The AdGuard Japanese filter was ENABLED and verified during the retests (version 2.0.77.44).** All five custom document exceptions were disabled for the initial comparisons; the later original-Japanese tests had Google Translate disabled.

- Kanji/idiom first-question access and Resort wall/menu access worked without their exceptions; those three exceptions were removed.
- **Paw remains unresolved:** with protection ON, the normal bonus-ad page stayed loading through approximately 65 seconds; with protection OFF, normal ad completion and bonus entry worked. The retained Paw exception is still unverified because a fresh eligible ad is required.
- The separate English vocabulary game is tracked in [#222607](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6148987274). Its gate disappeared with only the built-in AdGuard DNS filter disabled and returned when that filter was restored. The exact hostname/rule is unknown.

The original “Japanese disabled” and Chrome 140 entries below describe the historical initial report; the dated retests and installed Chrome 155.0.8059.39 correction supersede them. The Japanese-filter question was already answered in [the earlier follow-up](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/244149#issuecomment-6150655951) and is answered again in [this direct reply](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/244149#issuecomment-6157738716).

---

### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================


---

### Consolidated retest — 14 October 2026 (JST)

Following the maintainer's consolidation request, this update covers #244150 and #244151 alongside the original quizzes.

**Configuration:** AdGuard Japanese filter enabled, version **2.0.77.44**, displayed update **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. All five temporary document exceptions were disabled and checked before testing. The later tests used original Japanese, Google Translate disabled and Japanese first in Chrome's languages. Chrome remained muted with its per-app audio-focus operation set to ignore; these audio settings were unchanged between the Paw comparisons.
